config.description: Canvas engine for openmeteo_get_forecast / openmeteo_get_historical / openmeteo_get_marine / openmeteo_get_air_quality / openmeteo_get_ensemble / openmeteo_get_flood / openmeteo_get_climate spillover. Default 'duckdb' enables DataCanvas and the dataframe_query / dataframe_describe tools. Set to 'none' to disable — those tools still bound an over-budget response to a preview with truncated: true, but nothing stages the rows they omit.

config.description: Set to 'true' to make openmeteo_dataframe_drop callable — it removes one staged table or view from a DataCanvas. Default 'false' lists the tool as disabled. Has no effect unless CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=duckdb.
